## Summary

Describe the smallest coherent change in this PR.

## Why

What capability, bug or research question does this address?

## Validation

- [ ] Tests added or updated
- [ ] `make check` passes
- [ ] Public behavior documented
- [ ] Hardware/runtime risk considered

## Physical-system risk

Does this change affect actuator commands, safety constraints, timing, robot state interpretation or deployment behavior? If yes, describe the failure mode and rollback path.

## Reproducibility

For research changes, include config, seed, dataset version and checkpoint/experiment identifier.
